issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'And he said: I am the servant of Abraham' (וַיֹּאמַר עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אָנֹכִי). The Vietnamese renders 'Aùp-ra-ham nói' (Abraham said), attributing the speech to Abraham, but the Hebrew subject is 'he' (the servant, Eliezer), not Abraham. This changes who is speaking.
